name: bcard-namecard

scripts.check: node --check logic.js && node --check ocr.js && node --check app.js && node --check sw.js && node --check server.js && node --check build.js && node --check lib/config.js && node --check lib/local-db.js && node --check lib/supabase.js && node --check lib/auth.js && node --check lib/repository.js && node --check lib/storage.js && node --check lib/sync.js && node --check lib/company-resolver.js && node --check lib/company-research.js && node --check lib/production.js && node --check test/ocr-smoke.js && node --check test/ocr-live-card.js && node --check test/ocr-form-live-card.js && node --check test/visual-smoke.js && node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('manifest.json','utf8'))"
scripts.test: node --test test/logic.test.js test/ocr.test.js test/app.test.js test/config.test.js test/local-db.test.js test/auth.test.js test/repository.test.js test/sync.test.js test/storage.test.js test/research.test.js test/security-static.test.js
scripts.mobile:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.android: npm run mobile:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.ios: npm run mobile:sync && npx cap open ios
